sources.title: How and When Artificial Intelligence Awareness Fosters Proactive Career Behaviors: The Role of Workplace Impostor Thoughts and Future Work Self Salience
sources.summary: Drawing on self-discrepancy theory, this study examined how and when artificial intelligence (AI) awareness promotes proactive career behaviors. We collected three-wave, time-lagged data from 329 full-time employees in the United Kingdom. Results showed that AI awareness was positively related to proactive career behaviors.
